name: Summit Area YMCA Camps at Springfield Community Pool (Cannundus, Cannonball, Sports Camp)
description_short: Three YMCA day camps on the 15 acre Springfield Community Pool grounds for ages 4 to 13: Camp Cannundus (swim three times a week, mini golf, trips), Camp Cannonball (swim twice daily, half day option) and Sports Camp. A Summit Area YMCA membership is required.

fees.name: Membership
fees.note: Summit Area YMCA youth membership (ages 0 to 12); a SAY family membership also counts. A teen membership (13 to 17) is $60 a month

fees.name: Extended care (morning)
fees.note: Pre-Camp, 7 to 8:30 am; includes the morning bus where it applies

fees.name: Extended care (afternoon)
fees.note: Post Camp, 4 to 6:30 pm; includes the afternoon bus where it applies

refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable; refunds less the deposit until April 1, 2026, and none after.
swim_waterfront_notes: Springfield Community Pool: Cannundus and Sports Camp swim three times a week, Cannonball twice daily.
notes: Every camper needs an active Summit Area YMCA membership (youth membership $120 a year, teen $60 a month); there is no non-member rate. Pre-Camp 7 to 8:30 am ($95 a week) and Post Camp 4 to 6:30 pm ($110 a week) include the bus between the Summit or Berkeley Heights YMCA and the pool or reservation camps. Deposit $50 a week; refunds less the deposit before April 1, 2026, none after. Family members saved $10 a week before January 19. Camp 9 am to 4 pm. Camp Cannundus ages 4 to 13, weeks 1 to 10; Camp Cannonball ages 5 to 13, weeks 2 to 10, with half days 9 am to noon or 1 to 4 pm; Sports Camp ages 6 to 13, weeks 1 to 10. All $395 a week.
